title: Power BI Report Server Failures by Report
dataSources: Power BI Report Server execution log (`powerbi:reportserver`).
app: Power BI Report Server ExecutionLog via DB Connect and service logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=powerbi:reportserver status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by report_path
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Power BI Report Server failures grouped by report so operators immediately see which specific reports are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Power BI Report Server is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Power BI Report Server failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical reports.
visualization: Table of report by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Power BI Report Server are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
